ledgerRequirements.reason: readAttachmentPage cuts the parsed text with String.slice at UTF-16 offsets (offset 1, length 4 of an emoji, `a`, an emoji, `b`), so each cut that falls inside a surrogate pair leaves a lone surrogate. A Rust String cannot hold one; the Rust answer holds U+FFFD there, which is what the TypeScript string becomes once it is sent as UTF-8 (the answer goes to the model as JSON text). The input is valid Unicode; only the slice makes it lone. Final.
